meta.name: ElectricWaterHeater
meta.description: An electric-water-heater variant. It provides heat retention and stored-water volume-level settings.

heat_retention.description: Whether heat retention is enabled as a configuration setting. This setting persists across power changes and does not change the heating enable setting.

stored_water_volume_level.description: Configured stored-water preparation level: low, medium, or high. This is a relative volume setting, not a measurement of available water or a change to physical tank capacity. It persists across power changes.

get_heat_retention.description: Return the configured heat-retention enable setting. Fails while power is false; does not change state.

heat_retention.description: Whether heat retention is configured as enabled.

set_heat_retention.description: Set the heat-retention enable setting to the supplied boolean while powered on. Changes only this configuration setting, without changing heating_state or target temperature. Returns an empty response on success. Invalid arguments or power being false cause failure and leave all state unchanged.

value.description: Whether heat retention should be enabled.

get_stored_water_volume_level.description: Return the configured stored-water volume level as low, medium, or high. Fails while power is false; does not change state.

stored_water_volume_level.description: Configured relative stored-water preparation level: low, medium, or high.

set_stored_water_volume_level.description: Set the stored-water preparation level while powered on. Accepts exactly low, medium, or high, in increasing relative volume order. Changes only the configured level; it does not report instantaneous water availability or alter physical tank capacity. Returns an empty response on success. Invalid arguments or power being false cause failure and leave all state unchanged.
